items.html: And afterward the first three of Gadlut enter ZA, and also the Makifim of Ima alone, as mentioned elsewhere. And only the inner aspect has entered so far; and then they are corrected and become in the aspect of a Partzuf from his Chazeh downward. And this is on weekdays, when she did not have, even while in the back, more than from the Chazeh. But on Rosh HaShanah, while in the back, she ascended to the Keter; and now too her Partzuf grew up to the Keter. And see in its place how she is in Rachel and in Leah: but Rachel is from the Chazeh downward alone. And all this too is by the raising of the Mayin Nukvin for the coupling of Aba and Ima (and it needs much study elsewhere).
